title: The coups d'état: how the armed forces took power
goal: I can explain how the armed forces took power in the 1960s and 1970s, using contrast and concession connectors.
grammar: contrast and concession connectors like sin embargo and no obstante

items: I can say in which countries the armed forces took power.
I can say what the military said they wanted.
I can say how these governments differed from older dictatorships.
I can contrast two facts with *sin embargo*, *no obstante* and *aunque*.
I can contrast what the military said with what they did using *sin embargo* and *no obstante*.
I can say in which countries and years the armed forces took power.
I can say what the military said they wanted to defend.
I can say how some military governments differed from others.
I can name Velasco's government in Peru as a different case.
